name: wal_sync_method
description: Selects the system call used to force WAL writes to persistent storage, affecting durability guarantees and I/O performance.
tuning_tips: Prefer 'fdatasync' on Linux for best balance of safety and performance; use 'fsync' only if filesystem or storage lacks fdatasync support. Avoid 'open_sync' and 'open_datasync' unless benchmarking confirms benefit and hardware guarantees atomic writes.
